verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs list "Streaming outputs" as a core feature. It ships an OpenAI-compatible API server, a drop-in interface for streaming tokens back to applications, and its CLI prints TTFT statistics per response, which implies incremental output. However, the streaming claim appears only as a one-line feature bullet. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the streaming mechanics (e.g., SSE/stream parameter behavior, streaming with tool calls or structured outputs), independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming in practice.
